findings.issue: Command extractor spawns repo-configured argv with full parent env inherited; parent holds provider API keys (Anthropic/OpenAI/Jev), so any check.toml command can read and exfiltrate them. Separate leak path from NFR-SAG-0002 logs/errors.
findings.recommendation: env_clear() + explicit allowlist (PATH, HOME, LANG...); extra vars as documented opt-in in InputSpec. Same for git subprocesses (extract/read.rs:77, extract/mod.rs:175/189, sc-ai/src/command.rs:714) or at least GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0.
findings.evidence: Command::new(&argv[0]).args().current_dir().stdin(null).stdout(piped).stderr(piped) lines 130-136; no env_clear/env_remove/env anywhere in six crates.

findings.issue: read_worktree uses std::fs::read with no size cap; validate_relative is lexical only ('..', absolute, ':') so an in-repo symlink pointing outside (e.g. to ~/.ssh/id_rsa) is read and sent to the backend. git show path (line 77) buffers unbounded stdout. The 8 MiB caps used elsewhere do not apply here.
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize joined path; require regular file and starts_with canonical repo root; read via take(MAX+1); check metadata len. For git show stream through capped reader or git cat-file -s first.

findings.issue: System-prompt override read with unbounded read_to_string; absolute or repo-relative path; /dev/zero or huge file exhausts memory.
findings.recommendation: Require regular file; read via take(limit+1); ConfigInvalid on overflow; cap like MAX_SESSION_BYTES.

findings.issue: write_private tmp+fsync+rename is right shape but: tmp file left behind on error (holds system prompt and answers), parent dir not fsynced after rename, tmp name fixed per session id (safe only under in-process Mutex; two processes can interleave), session dir mode not tightened.
findings.recommendation: Remove tmp on error; OpenOptions::create_new with pid+random suffix; fsync parent dir; create dir 0700; TTL sweep of expired sessions and stale .tmp.
findings.evidence: lines 483-496 no cleanup on error path; io Mutex line 102 in-process only

findings.issue: Busy retry bounded (4 sends, Retry-After clamp 30s, 429/502/529 only) but no jitter and no overall deadline: worst case ~9.5 min blocking a thread (holds a Python call in sc-jev-py). Mirrored in sc-jev/src/client/retry.rs:24. thread::sleep not cancellable.
findings.recommendation: Total retry budget/deadline from first attempt capping Retry-After; small jitter; caller cancellation flag (KeyboardInterrupt in Python).

findings.issue: Both transports build a new ureq Agent per send (backends transport.rs:168 too): fresh TCP+TLS every call and every retry, no pool reuse. Jev transport sets only timeout_global, no connect timeout (backends has 10s).
findings.recommendation: One Agent per transport instance built in new() with connect timeout; per-request deadline per call; add timeout_connect to HttpsTransport.
findings.evidence: Agent::config_builder()...build().into() inside agent(), called from every send()
